settings.title: Annual Membership & Registration Fee
settings.description: Configuration of annual fee per student, academic year, and Codice Fiscale verification.
settings.toggleDesc: When active, the checkout system checks whether the student has already paid the fee for the current academic year. If inactive, courses can be booked without the registration fee surcharge.
settings.feeAmountHint: Amount charged once every 12 months for each registered Codice Fiscale.
settings.academicYearHint: Used for formal receipts, communication, and membership validity period.
settings.legalNoticeDesc: Annual registration fee is VAT-exempt (Art. 148 TUIR / DPR 633/72). When a parent books for a child, payment status verification is strictly based on the child's Codice Fiscale, while receipts and billing are issued to the parent (payer).
